findings.problem: MOO-ter suggests a long oo vowel, but the u in Mutter is short (MUT-ter, as in mutt), so the trick teaches a wrong pronunciation.
findings.fix: trick: MUTTER, said MUT-ter as in mutt, is close to MOTHER: picture a mother hugging her mutt.

note: Mutter also means a screw nut (plural die Muttern), but that does not affect this card.
